account.agent.prompt:
Install the Deskmates skill so you can operate my Deskmates instance for me.

1. Download {skillUrl} and save it as ~/.claude/skills/deskmates/SKILL.md (create the directory if needed). If you are not Claude Code, save it where your agent keeps skills.
2. Check whether ~/.config/deskmates/credentials exists and has mode 0600. If it is missing, stop and tell me: ‘Deskmates credentials are not enrolled. Enter the token through a local hidden-input or native secret-entry flow, then tell me when it is saved.’ Do not request, receive, or write the token through chat or a tool-call argument.
3. After I confirm enrollment, load the credential without printing it and verify GET {url}/api/workspaces with TLS certificate verification enabled. Tell me which workspaces you see.

Never print or log the token, never put it in a tracked file, and send it only to {url}. If TLS verification fails, stop and ask me to fix or explicitly trust the certificate; do not silently disable verification.
account.agent.role: Agent 使用密钥所分配的权限。请妥善保管密钥，不要公开分享。
account.agent.secretEntry: 仅将密钥粘贴到本地隐藏输入或原生机密录入流程。凭据文件权限必须为 0600；切勿把密钥发到聊天中。
